title: Lane A domain map: manifest EP14 EP113 EP222 duplicate rows collapsed to canonical EP numbers
body: During SOK_DOMAIN_MAP build, manifest contained duplicate EP rows for EP14 (ELECTRA vs Reformer), EP113 (agents vs FlashAttention), EP222 (exact dup). Collapsed to canonical EP numbers covering 1..478 exactly once. Census has no entries for EP13, EP117, EP222, EP326.
